name: Zahir Raihan
contribution: Zahir Raihan was a novelist, filmmaker, and cultural organiser whose work joined Bengali modernism to the political struggle for self-determination.
context: During the Liberation War he made the documentary Stop Genocide, using film to document atrocities and communicate Bangladesh’s case to international audiences.
impact: His films remain important records of wartime violence, cultural resistance, and the search for a Bengali national cinema.
